title: Eclipse’s ice cream is in a league of its own - Non-Dairy Ice Cream - Eclipse Foods
summary: While the meat alternatives category is suffering from some growing pains, investors’ enthusiasm for dairy alternatives continues unabated, with plant-based dairy specialist Eclipse Foods this week announcing a $40m series B round* led by Sozo Ventures, taking its cumulative funding to $60m. read more
body_markdown:
While the meat alternatives category is suffering from some growing pains, investors’ enthusiasm for dairy alternatives continues unabated, with plant-based dairy specialist Eclipse Foods this week announcing a $40m series B round* led by Sozo Ventures, taking its cumulative funding to $60m.


**[read more](https://www.foodnavigator-usa.com/Article/2022/06/28/Eclipse-s-ice-cream-is-in-a-league-of-its-own-Sozo-Ventures-leads-40m-series-B-round-at-plant-based-dairy-co-Eclipse-Foods#)**
